import json,os,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('/home/zech/Projects/.agent-scratch/894');out=s/'review3-final';out.mkdir()
os.environ['CARGO_BUILD_JOBS']='8';os.environ['TMPDIR']=str(s)
rows=[]
for label in ['backend','ui']:
 argv=['nice','-n','10','/usr/bin/python3',str(s/('review3-final-'+label+'.py'))]
 with (out/'commands.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'event':'start','argv':argv,'label':label})+'\n');f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
 with (out/(label+'.log')).open('wb') as f:r=subprocess.run(argv,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=False)
 with (out/'commands.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'event':'complete','argv':argv,'label':label,'exit_code':r.returncode})+'\n');f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
 rows.append({'label':label,'exit_code':r.returncode})
 if r.returncode:break
code=0 if len(rows)==2 and all(x['exit_code']==0 for x in rows) else 1
(out/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps({'head':'b38e11bc78fd0b6925352425e54b931a249101ba','exit_code':code,'results':rows},indent=2)+'\n')
sys.exit(code)
